abuts.method: worldgen.mine_abuts: kit pieces the plugins placed end to end (real meshes, mine_mounts contact band; child pivot outside the parent's plan; a side patch or every contact point on one side face), clustered per piece and per family on the child's offset in the parent's unit frame, the relative yaw and the relative scale. Run joints (opposite faces, offset along that axis) make endFaces, a piece's modular ends; double joints (face to face) are doubleFaces; terminates are the open faces runs end on; singleUse pieces stand alone in every plugin.
